description: Ground-truth QA set for a REAL, digital-native (text-layer) financial report — Apple Inc. condensed consolidated financial statements (unaudited) for the fiscal year (twelve months) ended September 30, 2023, released with the Q4 FY2023 results. Exercises the NATIVE (pdfplumber, non-OCR) ingestion path on an English filing. Only 3 pages: p1 Statements of Operations (income statement), p2 Balance Sheets, p3 Statements of Cash Flows. All figures verified directly against the source PDF. Currency: USD; all figures 'in millions, except per-share amounts and shares (in thousands)' unless noted. 'expected_pages' are 1-indexed PDF page numbers of THIS file (matching ingest_pdf 'page' metadata). Unless a question says 'three months', all income-statement / cash-flow figures are the TWELVE-MONTH (full-year) FY2023 column, compared with FY2022 (ended September 24, 2022). 'content_type' marks whether the answer lives in a table or narrative text.

questions.question: Which company do these financial statements belong to, and for which fiscal period are the full-year figures reported?
questions.ground_truth: Apple Inc. The full-year figures are for the twelve months ended September 30, 2023 (compared with the twelve months ended September 24, 2022).

questions.question: Are Apple's financial statements in this document audited or unaudited, and in what units are the figures presented?
questions.ground_truth: They are unaudited condensed consolidated financial statements. Figures are in millions of U.S. dollars, except per-share amounts and share counts (which are in thousands).

questions.question: What were Apple's total net sales for the twelve months ended September 30, 2023?
What were Products net sales for the full year fiscal 2023?
What were Services net sales for the full year fiscal 2023?
What was total cost of sales for the twelve months ended September 30, 2023?
What was Apple's gross margin for full-year fiscal 2023?
What was research and development expense for the twelve months ended September 30, 2023?
What were total operating expenses for full-year fiscal 2023?
What was operating income for the twelve months ended September 30, 2023?
What was Apple's net income for full-year fiscal 2023?
What were basic and diluted earnings per share for full-year fiscal 2023?
questions.ground_truth: Basic EPS $6.16 and diluted EPS $6.13 (FY2022: $6.15 basic, $6.11 diluted).

questions.question: What was iPhone net sales for the full year fiscal 2023?
What were net sales in Greater China for the twelve months ended September 30, 2023?
What were Apple's total assets as of September 30, 2023?
What were total current assets as of September 30, 2023?
What was cash and cash equivalents as of September 30, 2023?
What were inventories as of September 30, 2023?
What was net property, plant and equipment as of September 30, 2023?
What was accounts payable as of September 30, 2023?
What were total liabilities as of September 30, 2023?
What was total shareholders' equity as of September 30, 2023?
What was cash generated by operating activities for full-year fiscal 2023?
What was cash generated by (or used in) investing activities for full-year fiscal 2023?
What was cash used in financing activities for full-year fiscal 2023?
questions.ground_truth: $(108,488) million, i.e. $108,488 million of cash used (FY2022: $(110,749) million).

questions.question: How much did Apple pay for dividends and dividend equivalents in fiscal 2023?
How much did Apple spend on repurchases of common stock in fiscal 2023?
How much did Apple pay for acquisition of property, plant and equipment in fiscal 2023?
What was Apple's gross margin percentage (gross margin as a percentage of total net sales) for full-year fiscal 2023?
questions.ground_truth: Approximately 44.1% (gross margin $169,148 million / total net sales $383,285 million).
questions.notes: Reasoning: two income-statement lines then a ratio. Accept ~44%.

questions.question: Did Apple's total net sales grow or decline in fiscal 2023 versus fiscal 2022, and by roughly how much in percentage terms?
questions.ground_truth: They declined, from $394,328 million in FY2022 to $383,285 million in FY2023 — a decrease of about $11,043 million, roughly 2.8% lower.

questions.question: What was the share of Services in Apple's total net sales for full-year fiscal 2023?
questions.ground_truth: About 22.2% (Services $85,200 million / total net sales $383,285 million). Accept ~22%.
questions.notes: Reasoning: Services net sales divided by total net sales.

questions.question: What was Apple's total headcount (number of full-time employees) as of September 30, 2023?
questions.ground_truth: Not found. These condensed financial statements do not disclose employee headcount.
questions.notes: Negative test: employee count is not in these 3 statement pages; the system must abstain, not invent a figure.

questions.question: What is Apple's official total net sales guidance (target figure) for fiscal year 2024?
questions.ground_truth: Not found. This document reports fiscal 2023 results and does not provide a numerical revenue target/guidance for fiscal 2024.
questions.notes: Negative/trap test: no forward guidance number in the filing.
